## What does this PR change?

- [ ] journal profile (`journals/`) — state which venue and the official source you verified
- [ ] checklist items — state which referee complaint / recurring defect they encode

## Quality gate (project rules apply to contributions too)

- [ ] No "one-click paper generation" content (violates the project's integrity red lines)
- [ ] No copyrighted prompt text copied; borrowed rules are rewritten and attributed (update docs/10 lineage)
- [ ] AI-assisted contributions state how they were verified
- [ ] Terminology consistent with `docs/glossary-中英术语表.md`
- [ ] Scripts tested locally (`python scripts/<name>.py <args>`); exit code convention respected
- [ ] Both language versions updated where applicable (zh canonical + en), or a note on which needs translation
